AlertMessage: One or more organisation-month records do not match all three sources
Caveat: Investigate data coverage before interpreting performance

AlertMessage: Unexpected rejected records require review before publication
Caveat: Published aggregate TOTAL rows are expected controlled exclusions and do not trigger this alert

AlertMessage: Four-hour performance is below the 78% March 2025 objective
Caveat: The objective applies to March 2025 and is displayed across the period as a reference benchmark

AlertMessage: Demand increased while estimated available capacity decreased
Caveat: Estimated available FTE is a capacity proxy rather than rostered availability

AlertMessage: Sickness absence increased from the previous month
Caveat: Any increase is flagged for investigation and is not automatically a performance failure

AlertMessage: Attendances per estimated available FTE increased from the previous month
Caveat: The ratio does not measure clinical productivity or patient complexity

AlertMessage: A revised or replacement source file is active for at least one reporting period
Caveat: Confirm reconciliation against the superseded file
